People_counter.label: People counter
People_counter.description: The uCIFI people counter provides people counting information using Bluetooth beacon or any other method.

Actual_number_of_persons.label: Actual number of persons
Actual_number_of_persons.description: Number of persons currently identified by the device.

Daily_number_of_persons.label: Daily number of persons
Daily_number_of_persons.description: Cumulated number of persons detected by the device since beginning of the day.

Cumulated_number_of_persons.label: Cumulated number of persons
Cumulated_number_of_persons.description: Cumulated number of persons detected by the device since last reset.

Daily_number_of_passages.label: Daily number of passages
Daily_number_of_passages.description: Number of passages (same people could be counted multiple times if identified several times) today.

Cumulated_number_of_passages.label: Cumulated number of passages
Cumulated_number_of_passages.description: Cumulated number of passages since last reset.

Type_of_sensor.label: Type of sensor
Type_of_sensor.description: Type of sensor (e.g. Bluetooth beacon, WIFI detector).

Reset_of_cumulated_number.label: Reset of cumulated number
Reset_of_cumulated_number.description: Reset the cumulated number of persons.

Reset_of_cumulated_number_of_passages.label: Reset of cumulated number of passages
Reset_of_cumulated_number_of_passages.description: Reset the cumulated number of passages.
